THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

2. Sri Varun R.R. learned advocate appearing for Sri Sharan N Majage, learned counsel for petitioner submitted that land bearing Sy.no.13/3, measuring 15 guntas of land situated at Chapparadahalli village, Kundana Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk, Bengaluru Rural District, originally belonged to petitioner's father Sri Venkataramanappa and revenue records were standing in his name.
After his death i.e., 12.01.2000, wife and children were absolute owners of said land.
Petitioner is one of his son.

It was submitted that respondents - authority had initiated acquisition of aforesaid land for establishment of NC: 2023:KHC:41415 industrial area under Preliminary Notification dated 09.06.2010 and Final Notification dated 25.05.2022.
Subsequent to death of his father, mother, brother and sisters executed consent deed dated 17.10.2023 giving consent to release compensation in favour of petitioner.

It was submitted that though petitioner was entitled to higher Sri Munikrishnappa vs The State Of Karnataka on 18 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85159105/
2 compensation under consent award, General Award was passed by respondent no.3, which was under challenge.

sentences.text: Hence sought for allowing writ petition.
3. On other hand, Sri Yogesh D Nayak, learned AGA for respondent no.1 and Sri H.L. Pradeep Kumar, learned counsel for respondents no.2 and 3 submitted that in view of earlier decisions,
respondent
no.3 would consider representation, in accordance with law.

4. Heard learned counsel and perused writ petition record.
5.

From above submission and as under similar circumstances, this Court allowed several writ petitions, including W.P.No.31702/2018 disposed of on 29.11.2018, contention of petitioner therein about failure to provide opportunity to accept compensation under consent award which was higher than under General award was upheld and this Court set aside General Award and directed respondents to NC: 2023:KHC:41415 consider petitioner's representation for passing consent award.
Said decision would squarely apply in this case.

6. Accordingly, Writ petition is disposed of, impugned General Award bearing No.KIADB/LAQ/2014-2023-24 dated 06.06.2023 passed by respondent no.3 in respect of land bearing Sy.no.13/3, measuring 15 guntas of land situated at Chapparadahalli Village, Kundana Hobli, Devenahalli Taluk, Bengaluru Rural District, as per Annexure-G, is hereby set aside.
Respondent no.3 shall consider petitioner's representation and pass appropriate orders thereon within a period of eight weeks.

Needless to observe that direction issued to consider representation shall not be construed as a positive direction to grant relief sought in representation, but only as a direction to consider representation on its own merit in accordance with law.

Sd/-
JUDGE psg*
